question: Simplify (cos ⁴ θ-sin ⁴ θ)/(sin ² θ)
solution:
**Given:**

(cos ⁴ θ-sin ⁴ θ)/(sin ² θ)

**Concept Used:**

Sin²θ + Cos²θ = 1

(a + b)(a – b) = a² – b²

**Calculation:**

⇒ According to the question

⇒ (cos ⁴ θ-sin ⁴ θ)/(sin ² θ) = ( (cos ² θ+sin ² θ) ( cos ²θ-sin ² θ))/(sin ² θ)

⇒ ( (1) ( cos ²θ-sin ² θ))/(sin ² θ) = ( cos ² θ)/(sin ² θ) – 1 = cot2 θ – 1

**Therefore, the value of (cos ⁴ θ-sin ⁴ θ)/(sin ² θ) is cot2 θ – 1.**
